title: Great introduction to Barcelona food scene.
text: We enjoyed this food tour.  We visited La Boqueria food market and I was shocked and impressed with the large selection of fresh food.  We also stopped for two samplings.  The tour guide was friendly and informative.
author: Sabrina_C

title: Fabulous food tour
text:
This is a great way to see behind the scenes in a city and eat delicious local food 
Sophia was full of little facts and interesting history. I really recommend going on this tour with her
author: Sophie_M

title: Great food and tour
text: Great tour of old town and unique areas.  Vincent was a wonderful tour guide with lots of information about tapas and area.
author: Kristina_N

title: Great tour!
text: Knowledgeable and friendly guide. We are so thankful we took this tour! Plenty of local foods to taste and just enough walking to get an overview of the area.
author: Kimberly_H

title: Had a great tour of 2...
text: Had a great tour of 2 markets and other good stops along the way. Fun & informative.  Francisco our guide was fabulous, couldn’t wish for a better tour guide.
author: Annette_S

title: Extremally knowledgeable...
text: Extremally knowledgeable guy  (so sorry forgotten your name). Great way to get to know local food and a bit of a city. Had lovely time.
author: Annna_W

title: Great pace and food!
text: Walking and history in a great pace coupled with great snacks along the way.  Guide was knowledgable and made all participants comfortable.  Great size of tour.
author: Stephanie_P

title: Amazing tour , 100% recommended
text: Excellent! The was an amazing story teller. Loved how she wove her life into information about city & the delicious samples of food on the tour. Highly recommended!
author: Marie_M

title: Great way to learn about spanish food
text: I did not know much about spanish food and Pep made me discover some delicious specialties. The visit of the city was also pleasant and informative.
author: Gabriele_F
